en.quote: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
en.riddle: I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
en.speaker: servant

he.quote: וְאִם־אָמֹר יֹאמַר הָעֶבֶד אָהַבְתִּי אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־אִשְׁתִּי וְאֶת־בָּנָי לֹא אֵצֵא חָפְשִֽׁי
